The object titled Rooster and coxcomb was created by Qi Baishi.
The object titled Rooster and coxcomb belongs to the Asian Art department at the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
The medium of the object titled Rooster and Coxcomb is a hanging scroll.
A hanging scroll is a traditional Chinese painting format.
Hanging scroll artworks are usually created in ink on paper.
Hanging scroll artworks are mounted on silk for display.
